newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines in N.Y. ad blitz.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines in N.Y. ad blitz.

text.p: Continental Airlines, the nation's fifth largest air carrier, said Tuesday it is launching an advertising campaign to tell New Yorkers that its Newark, N.J., hub is an ideal point to start a flight.

The multi-million blitz kicks off tonight at Ellis Island, the historic gateway for millions of immigrants to the U.S., where the company and its chairman, Gordon Bethune, will fete close to a thousand travel industry executives.
The drive will include radio and newspaper advertisements, direct mail and promotional events.
One ad copy reads: "Need to feel like a real New Yorker? Eat a bagel on your way to Newark."
Another says, "If you fly Continental out of Newark, raise your hand. The rest of you, raise your standards." The ads end with the admonition to "Fly Continental Out of Newark."
The campaign, hatched by N.W. Ayer & Partners, will continue through the end of the year.
Continental operates major hubs in Newark, Houston, Guam and Cleveland. It has more than 2,000 jet and Express departures daily to 129 domestic and 59 international destinations.
